question: Should `ClawSegmentedControl` globally wrap every option set larger than four, or should responsive wrapping be limited to Skill Workshop through a dedicated filter surface?
rationale: Both approaches can fix the demonstrated truncation, but they establish different shared Android design-system semantics that cannot be selected safely from tests and proof alone.

options.title: Narrow to Skill Workshop
options.body: Preserve the shared control’s single-row behavior and render these five filters with a dedicated responsive chip or wrapped-filter component.

options.title: Approve global wrapping
options.body: Accept multi-row layout and variable height as the shared contract for all segmented controls larger than four, then refresh the branch against current main.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Skill Workshop
recommendation.body: Preserve the shared control’s single-row behavior and render these five filters with a dedicated responsive chip or wrapped-filter component.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android app owner, and this decision governs a shared Android UI component.
